title: GameViewFields
responsibility: Select game views in a compact toolbar and progressively disclose view title, dimension and art direction.

inputs.name: GameViewFields.view
inputs.description: The active game view supplies the selected id and the title, dimension, and art direction shown in settings. Its planning state controls whether Level is shown, and LevelValidator.isReady(view) gates Preview and Checkpoints.

planning.concept: Guide a lantern through the forest.
planning.description: Reach the old bridge before nightfall.

inputs.name: GameViewFields.views
inputs.description: The game views offered in the picker; each option uses a view id as its value and title as its label. More than one view expands the picker.

planning.concept: Guide a lantern through the forest.
planning.description: Reach the old bridge before nightfall.

examples.title: Moonlit harbor
examples.style: Low-poly shapes with soft blue light

inputs.name: GameViewFields.readonly
inputs.description: When true, the title, dimension, and art direction editors are disabled, a read-only note is shown, and New view is hidden. Defaults to false.

inputs.name: GameViewFields.section
inputs.description: The currently selected workspace section; it must be Level, Preview, Checkpoints, or Mechanics, and New view sets it to Level. It is bindable and has no runtime fallback, so an omitted value is undefined even though the declared prop type requires it.

inputs.name: GameViewFields.select
inputs.description: Called with the selected view id when a picker option is chosen, and with the newly created id after New view. It receives only the id string.

inputs.name: GameViewFields.create
inputs.description: Called when New view is activated in an editable view, with a new view using the current dimension and art direction, title New level, empty checkpoints, and blank planning text. Selection and the section change to Level follow only if this callback returns normally.

inputs.name: GameViewFields.change
inputs.description: Called for title and art direction edits and for dimension changes, with a partial view patch. A dimension change also clears approved and built to undefined in a copied planning object when planning is present; other planning fields are retained.

outputs.name: GameViewFields
outputs.description: Renders a View picker that expands when more than one view is supplied, plus section buttons; Level appears only when view.planning is truthy, and Preview and Checkpoints are disabled unless LevelValidator.isReady(view) succeeds. The toolbar ends with New view and a View settings icon button; View settings opens a shared Modal, closed at first, with the title, 2D/3D dimension and art direction fields, so no form sits inline; when readonly is true their editors are disabled, a read-only note is shown, and New view is hidden.

errors.name: Caller callback error
errors.description: A synchronous exception thrown by select, create, or change propagates from the event handler; the component does not catch it. In createLevel, a thrown create prevents selection and local section updates, and a thrown select prevents those local updates.
